title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Key Ratios Every Investor Should Know

questions.text: Which ratio shows how much investors pay for each unit of a company's profit?
questions.explanation: The P/E ratio compares share price to earnings per share to indicate what investors pay for profit.

questions.text: True or false: A higher Debt-to-Equity ratio indicates lower financial risk.
questions.explanation: A higher Debt-to-Equity ratio shows greater reliance on debt, which reflects higher financial risk.
